name: D.K. Engineering (Holdings) Limited
note: Companies House 09461599, private limited company, incorporated 27 February 2015, registered office Rickmansworth. The DK logo and the DK Engineering name are its registered trade marks (footer of dkeng.co.uk). Its active person with significant control is James Roderick Cottingham (more than 50% but less than 75% of shares and voting rights, notified 10 October 2025); its directors are David Alan, James Roderick and Katherine Mary Cottingham. DK Engineering, the business behind the brand, was founded in 1977 by David and Kate Cottingham; their son James Cottingham is its managing director and races the #91 Manthey DK Engineering Porsche in the 2026 WEC.
